conventions.convention: The De Concini–Kac form uses ordinary generators over the localization inverting v_i−v_i⁻¹; the Lusztig form includes all divided powers and toral quantum binomials. Generic inclusion does not imply injectivity after specialization.

In higher rank, imposing only simple-root powers defines a candidate quotient, not the standard small quantum group. The small algebra used subsequently is the actual ordinary-generator image in a specified toral quotient.
The tilting branch uses a simple simply-laced system, full weight lattice P, coroot torus Q∨, and odd ℓ>h with ord(ζ²)=ℓ. Both ord(ζ)=ℓ and ord(ζ)=2ℓ are permitted.

Type 1 includes the formal P-weight grading, every toral quantum-binomial character, and all divided-power weight shifts. Quantum binomials are evaluated as Laurent polynomials, including negative upper indices.
The braiding includes the chosen symmetric bicharacter χ(λ,μ)=t^{D(λ,μ)}, where t^D=ζ. No determinant coprimality or modularity is assumed.
The library coproduct is Δ(E_i)=E_i⊗K_i⁻¹+1⊗E_i and Δ(F_i)=F_i⊗1+K_i⊗F_i. The compatible pivot is K_{−2ρ∨}, and R=D⁻¹Θ⁻¹.

Strong affine linkage requires finite chains of strictly downward reflections in shifted coordinates; intermediate labels need not be dominant. Orbit membership plus dominance is not substituted for this condition.
The surviving alcove is open: A_ℓ consists of dominant ν with (ν+ρ,θ)<ℓ. Closed-bottom Weyl modules on the upper wall are simple tiltings but have zero quantum dimension.

The Frobenius branch requires ζ itself to have primitive odd order ℓ, standard symmetrizers coprime to ℓ, and a semisimple isogeny lattice. Its stated kernel is an algebra Hopf ideal, not an identification of coinvariants.

load_bearing.statement: In the exact simply connected, simply-laced, full-weight-lattice and odd ℓ>h branch, the full toral-weight category is a complex-linear abelian braided rigid monoidal category, with pivot K_{−2ρ∨} and equal pivotal traces for every endomorphism.

A finite dimensional integrable based module of finite Cartan type in the exact four-axiom sense has a finite filtration of its actual integral basis lattice by basis-subset submodules, with integral highest-lattice sections and free quotients; every nonzero complex specialization retains the injections.

Every finite saturated dominant-label truncation of the actual root category has a finite-dimensional algebra model, projective and injective standard-costandard filtrations, and projective reciprocity.

Weyl and dual Weyl flags are summand closed; standard-costandard Hom is diagonal one-dimensional and every extension of a Weyl-filtered module by a dual-Weyl-filtered module splits. Indecomposable tiltings have unique maximal labels of multiplicity one and are unique at a prescribed maximal label.

For the selected simply-laced datum and L=ord(ζ), the actual ordinary image in U^L_ζ/(K_i^L−1) has residue root-PBW triangular bases, dimension L^{|I|}ℓ^{2|Φ⁺|}, braid-stable decompositions, and free induction from the stated minimal parabolics.
Every composition label of a Weyl or dual Weyl module at λ, and every Weyl section and composition label of T_ζ(λ), is obtained from λ by the specified downward affine-reflection chains.

For every integral point in the open bottom alcove and every facet, an integral relative-interior facet point exists whose displacement has dominant representative in the closed bottom alcove; the assertion transports to every affine alcove.

For a relative-interior facet point x and interior alcove point y, affine orbit pairs have distance at least ‖x−y‖, with the stated common-isometry equality case. For a lower facet and a downward chain from x, every paired regular orbit point at that distance is at most y in root order.

The pivotal trace radical is a two-sided tensor ideal. Its quotient is idempotent-complete, semisimple, braided, rigid and spherical, with simple classes exactly the indecomposable tiltings of nonzero quantum dimension.
For every dominant μ outside A_ℓ, T_ζ(μ) has zero quantum dimension and negligible identity. For ν in A_ℓ, T_ζ(ν)=Δ_ζ(ν) is simple and has nonzero quantum dimension.

At a primitive root of odd order ℓ, symmetric quantum binomials satisfy the stated Lucas formula, including negative upper indices; every specialized divided-power family is generated by X and X^{(ℓ)} with the stated factorial formula.
For primitive odd order ℓ>2, the rank-one De Concini–Kac specialization has its ordinary PBW basis, and its quotient by E^ℓ, F^ℓ and K^ℓ−1 is a Hopf algebra with residue basis and dimension ℓ³.
